map.输入 “12”：首字符为数字，先输出数字符 ⠼（点3,4,5,6），再按 1→a: Entering "12": the first character is a digit, so the number sign ⠼ is output first (dots 3,4,5,6), then 1→a's pattern ⠁ and 2→b's pattern ⠃ (consecutive digits do not repeat the number sign), 3 braille cells in total. Entering "ab": a→⠁, b→⠃, 2 cells in total. The whole phrase "hello 2026" has 5 letters and 4 digits, so with the number sign and the space it is 11 cells in total (hello=5, space=1, 2026 = number sign + 4 digits = 5).
map.数字在盲文中如何表示？: How are digits represented in braille?
map.盲文数字借用 a~j 的点位（1→a、2→b……9→i、0→j），且数字前需加数: Braille digits borrow the patterns of a~j (1→a, 2→b……9→i, 0→j), and a number sign ⠼ must be added before the digits; consecutive digits add the number sign only once at the start. This tool already handles this rule automatically.
map.中文能直接转盲文吗？: Can Chinese be transliterated directly into braille?
map.本工具采用一级盲文（Grade 1）逐字转译，仅支持拼音字母、英文与数字。中文需: This tool uses Grade 1 braille for character-by-character transliteration and supports only pinyin letters, English and digits. Chinese must first be converted to pinyin (initial + final + tone); you can use the site's "pinyin converter" tool and paste the result in.
map.盲文点字转译与点位分布图生成，辅助盲文学习与教学，数据全部本地处理、不上传。: Braille cell transliteration and dot pattern diagram generation, assisting braille learning and teaching, with all data processed locally and never uploaded.
map.先按大小写模式把原文整体转为大写或小写（保留模式不改）。逐字符处理：空格直接输出: First convert the whole text to upper or lower case according to the case mode (preserve mode leaves it unchanged). Then handle each character: a space outputs a space and resets the digit state; letters are looked up for their dot pattern, and in preserve mode a capital sign is prefixed to uppercase letters; a digit sign is prefixed before the first digit of a run, and digit n maps to a letter — 1→a, …, 9→i, 0→j, i.e. letter j when n is 0, otherwise the 97 + n − 1 lowercase letter, whose dot pattern is then looked up; other punctuation is output as-is. Character count is tallied and a dot-pattern image is rendered

map.适用范围：本工具只用拉丁字母、数字与空格做一级盲文（Grade 1）逐字符映射，: Scope: this tool only performs character-by-character Grade 1 braille mapping of Latin letters, digits and spaces; it is not Chinese braille translation. Chinese must first be converted to pinyin letters without tone marks. Chinese characters, punctuation and accented letters explicitly produce an “unsupported characters” error and are never mixed into the result.
map.输入 “12”：首字符为数字，先输出数字符 ⠼（点3,4,5,6），再按 1→a: Entering “12”: the first character is a digit, so the number sign ⠼ (dots 3,4,5,6) is output first, then 1→a gives ⠁ and 2→b gives ⠃ (consecutive digits do not repeat the number sign), for 3 braille cells. Entering “1a”: a letter immediately follows a digit, so a letter sign ⠰ (dots 5,6) ends numeric mode before a, producing ⠼⠁⠰⠁, 4 cells; without the letter sign the second ⠁ would be misread as digit 1. Entering “ab”: a→⠁, b→⠃, 2 cells; in “all caps” mode the output is ⠠⠁⠠⠃, 4 cells.
map.输入“你好”或“你好，世界”：工具不输出任何盲文结果，而是在结果区列出未支持字符: Entering Chinese characters such as U+4F60 / U+4F60 with U+FF0C, or ordinary punctuation: the tool outputs no braille at all; instead it lists the unsupported characters in the result area and states that only Latin letters, digits and spaces are accepted. This prevents Chinese characters from being mixed verbatim into a braille string and mistaken for usable Chinese braille.

map.“全部大写”和“保留原样”有什么区别？: What is the difference between “all caps” and “preserve case”?
map.“全部大写”先把整段文本转成大写，再在每个字母前加大写符 ⠠，例如 a → ⠠⠁: “All caps” first converts the whole text to uppercase, then adds a capital sign ⠠ before every letter, for example a → ⠠⠁; “preserve case” adds the capital sign only to letters that were uppercase in the original and adds nothing to lowercase letters; “all lowercase” adds no capital sign. The dot diagram and the copied result use the same dot string, so the display and the copy never diverge.
